function: Excluded, system: over-the-air federated learning aggregation (area 7) on a single-antenna link, no RIS; p. 4 'K signal antenna edge devices and one signal antenna base station'.
notes: Excluded with code system (code 6). The paper (PAOTA) is an area 7 work: semi-asynchronous aggregation of local models through AirComp with uplink transmit power control (abstract, p. 1; Section III, p. 5). Its link has one antenna at every edge device and one antenna at the BS, and no RIS: p. 4, Section II-C, 'consists of K signal antenna edge devices and one signal antenna base station (BS) for global model aggregation' ('signal' is a typo of 'single'); the uplink channel h_k^r is a scalar complex coefficient (p. 4, Eq. 6) with i.i.d. Rayleigh fading and perfect CSI (p. 9). Codes 1 to 5 do not apply: it is a research article that proposes and evaluates a method, federated learning over the air passes the learning check, and the problem is the over-the-air aggregation itself. It reports quantitative results (Figs. 5 to 9, Table II, pp. 9 to 12), so code 7 is not reached.
